feeds.title: Leadership Now Blog
feeds.description: Leading Blog encourages people to lead from where they are. We highlight issues of interest to leaders and have links to sources of information on the web. More than book reviews, the commentary points to the fundamentals of leadership that will help you to meet today's leadership challenges.

feeds.title: ICM Canada Blog
feeds.description: ICM Canada is a a non-profit society supported by those who believe in our values and strategy. It began in 1989 (as Global Outreach Association) by the Jeskes. In 1990, they joined two other American families in East Africa in response to the great need of leadership training in the African church.

feeds.title: Catholic Women's Leadership Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The Catholic Women's Leadership Foundation enables an influential voice for Catholic women in Canada through collaboration, education, and supportive networks. Our goal is to become the leading authority in Canadian Catholic women's leadership through the development of diverse programs and activities.

feeds.title: Bonar Institute for Purposeful Leadership  Blog
feeds.description: We are an advisory firm established in Ottawa, Ontariothat provides its clients with advisements, courses, and curriculum-based training. The Bonar Institute was founded in 2014 by Dr. James de Gaspé Bonar to enable high-growth companies to optimize their executive talent through purposeful leadership.

feeds.title: IT World Canada » Leadership
feeds.description: Since its launch in 1984, IT World Canada has become the online information resource of choice for Canadian IT professionals and was ranked 2nd at the COPA Awards 2020. We are dedicated to providing an arsenal of relevant news and developments from the IT industry through digital publications and events. In the Leadership section get information Technology news on products, services, and issues for CIOs, IT managers, and network admins

feeds.title: Sustainability Leadership Blog
feeds.description: Sustainability Leadership was originally launched as Sustainable Hamilton in June 2011 by Sandi Stride with the help of a Founding Board of Directors and small team of volunteers. One of the first actions was to recruit a cross-sectoral advisory committee to gain input from sustainability experts in academia, municipal & provincial government, NGOs, and businesses large & small.

feeds.title: Refresh Leadership » Leadership and Management
feeds.description: Refresh Leadership is a place to talk about all things leadership. A place to get fresh, innovative ideas about leading in today's workplace - no matter what your title! Join us to talk about management, leadership, the workplace, HR, and more. The Leadership and Management section offers quick, fresh, practical advice for today's business leaders, from executives to emerging leadership. Powered by Express Employment Professionals.

feeds.title: FreshBooks Blog » Leadership
feeds.description: FreshBooks makes accounting painless for millions of small business owners. But your work doesn't end there. Our blog is here to help! With actionable insights into all aspects of running a small business, FreshBooks helps you thrive. In the leadership section get information and inspiration on how to start a business, grow your business, tax tips, freelancing & more from FreshBooks!
